title: Sentinel-safe earthquake swarm-excess structural ridge under transtension and basin cover
method_paragraph: From the SHA-256-pinned 19-band competition feature stack, mask every non-finite or <= -1e30 sentinel before transforming Band 10 deq_n100a15, Band 16 ieq_n100a15, Band 3 tmi_hg, Band 18 iso_grav_anom_hg, Band 7 geod_shearrate, Band 8 geod_dilaterate and Band 15 depth_to_base_surf. Compute a label-free swarm-excess rank from log1p(deq)-log1p(ieq); magnetic and gravity edge ranks; a structure-tensor coherence of their geometric-mean edge field; a positive transtension rank from positive shear times positive dilatation; and a log-depth-to-basement cover rank. The fixed candidate is swarm_excess^1.5 * (0.20+0.80*edge_coherence) * (0.35+0.65*transtension) * (0.40+0.60*cover), with support restricted prospectively to swarm_excess >= 0.60 and edge_coherence >= 0.35, then rescaled to [0,1]. It uses no fault catalogue, registry raster or hidden label as an input. Evaluate this fixed surface without fitted weights on buffered whole-component holds (seeds 20 and 30), masking visible catalogue pixels exactly, using the shared pooled 300 m DTI evaluator. The competition-format live TIFF is the same fixed thresholded continuous surface with mapped catalogue pixels zeroed; there is no adaptive dot placement or holdout-selected hyperparameter.
hypothesis: Catalogue-missing blind intrabasin transfer and accommodation faults are enriched where dependent earthquake swarm excess is spatially organized into a coherent magnetic-gravity structural ridge under positive transtension and thick basin cover.
mechanism: Active permeable fracture meshes can concentrate clustered seismicity while displacing magnetic/density boundaries; burial suppresses a Quaternary surface scarp, and extensional/transtensional strain helps distinguish an active structure from an inherited contact.
named_non_fault_process: Open-pit mine blasts, geothermal injection or production-induced seismicity, and mainshock aftershock halos can elevate the seismic contrast; lithologic contacts and survey artifacts can provide an unrelated edge.
why_missing_from_catalogue: The USGS Quaternary compilation is based on evidence of Quaternary surface deformation and simplifies trace geometry. Buried intrabasin strands under thick alluvium can lack a persistent surface rupture while retaining subsurface and seismic expressions.
difference_from_implemented_repo: THVC, COV, CSMD and DFSD include deq_n100a15 and ieq_n100a15 as separate raw learner channels. No implemented source constructs this closed log-ratio x dual-edge-coherence x transtension x cover operator. It uses no CONJ cross-strike catalogue geometry and no FSC visible-fault fabric field.

fixed_transforms.valid: footprint & isfinite(all seven bands) & all seven bands > -1e30
fixed_transforms.edge_coherence: edge * C, where C=sqrt((Jxx-Jyy)^2+4*Jxy^2)/(Jxx+Jyy+1e-6), gradients of Gaussian(edge,sigma=1.5), tensor Gaussian sigma=4
fixed_transforms.output: candidate/support linearly rescaled by its valid maximum to [0,1]; zero elsewhere, outside footprint and on visible/full mapped catalogue as appropriate

experiments.purpose: Leakage canaries for every base/derived feature alone on both holdout seeds; symmetric ROC AUC > 0.90 blocks score trust.
One fixed primary candidate evaluated on both seeds with preregistered swarm-only, edge-only and deterministic uniform controls; no arm is selected after seeing holdout.

holdout.metric: pooled DTI alpha=0.2 beta=0.8, 300 m triangular kernel
holdout.ci: 1000-draw paired physical 20 km spatial-block percentile bootstrap

literal_novelty.known_result_before_lane: impossible_under_literal_gate: pinned registry witness covers every allowed cell, so every nonempty candidate overlaps 1.0
literal_novelty.policy: Do not reinterpret or silently exempt the witness. Any generated research TIFF is automatically negative/DO-NOT-SUBMIT and uses zero weekly slots.

score_policy: No leaderboard projection. HOLDOUT-DTI is labelled with evaluator, withheld n and CI. ORGANIZER-CONFIRMED requires a submission-page receipt.
artifact_policy: The urgent unique-file requirement is satisfied only as a format-valid negative research artifact. It cannot be promoted under the unchanged literal overlap rule.
